== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster excludes Force drains generally, whereas the first surviving wording excludes Force drains at a battleground. It drops the express bar on further reduction. Both retain the occupied-battleground amount and minimum of 1, the initial 1-Force loss option and activation on the opposing icons.
